stem: To get July's MQL to SQL conversion, an analyst divides the SQL dates recorded in July by the MQL dates recorded in July. What is the problem?

options.text: None, since both counts come from the same calendar month
Many July SQLs come from leads that were MQLs in earlier months
SQLs must be divided by all leads created in July, not by MQLs
July has 31 days, so the counts must first be scaled to 30 days
